moves.notes: Always followed by For the Queen.

moves.name: Tongue Lash
moves.notes: Always followed by Strike Down Evil. Always used at the start of combat. If Frog Knight is already charged or still at/above half HP, this branch replaces "Beetle Charge".

moves.name: Beetle Charge
moves.notes: Always followed by Tongue Lash. Only triggers while Frog Knight is below half HP and has not used "Beetle Charge" yet. After using it, Frog Knight is marked as charged.
